capability.summary: Address three Copilot review threads on PR #35 (post-rebase): (1) Export Loops onclick now clears the export-error class + tooltip before retrying so a transient failure doesn't latch the UI; (2) add CSS rule for #export-loops-btn.export-error so the failure state is actually visible (red border/text) not just a tooltip; (3) gate previewSample's catch and trailing selectBrowserItem on a per-invocation token so a late failure for index i cannot clobber a newer in-flight invocation for the same i (the onclick+ondblclick wiring makes double-fires possible).

controls.description: Clicking the Export Loops button removes any prior export-error class + resets the tooltip before invoking exportLoopsZip, so a successful retry after a failure starts in a clean state.
controls.test: Existing 'Export Loops produces a ZIP' e2e exercises the success path; the additional onclick reset is verified by the same test passing (no export-error class on a successful run after construction).

controls.description: #export-loops-btn.export-error CSS rule sets red border, red text, faint red background so the failure state is visible (matches .browser-item-preview.preview-error).
controls.test: Visible-on-fail covered by the existing 'Export Loops surfaces an error state when render throws' e2e (asserts class + title); CSS rule is colocated with the existing busy/preview-error rules.

controls.description: previewSample uses lastPreviewToken: Map<number, number> + previewTokenCounter. A late catch for index i only mutates UI (preview-error class/title, previewingIdx, selectBrowserItem) if its token is still the latest one recorded for i.
controls.test: Existing 'a slow failing preview does not clobber a newer in-flight preview' e2e still passes (each row owns its own token); the per-index token specifically prevents same-i double-fires (dblclick) from corrupting the newer invocation's UI.
